sources.quote: From Old East Slavic дѣдѩ (dědję), baby-talk assimilation of Old East Slavic дѣдъ (dědŭ) (compare дід (did)). Displaced Ukrainian стрий (stryj, “paternal uncle”) and вуй (vuj, “maternal uncle”) in most dialects.
